items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] For a while Dodo Marmarosa was the piano player right? [INTERVIEWEE] He always had good piano players.

ctx.x: It wasn’t orchestral music, it was meant to be piano music but I don't blame him, he had to live with the stuff on the road so he wanted to make sure he had something he could tune up to.
For a while Dodo Marmarosa was the piano player right?
He always had good piano players.
